params.prompt: The text says the round is open. Open Book shifts and tap a day. At the top, AM or PM. Below it, one chip per zone: Open means it's yours to take, and a taken one shows who has it. Tap a zone, and it's booked, there and then. No basket, nothing to confirm. The receipt is the thing to look at: that's your share, booked. Add another day the same way. If a colleague tapped the same slot a moment before you, you're told at once, and you tap another. When the round closes, your admin publishes, and the whole roster lands on your phone.
